parts.header:
/** 🌐️ The `publish` verb: the site built with the proctor origin baked in, the CDN artifact verified (entry points, sealed document, hashed assets, no development leftovers, size budget) and staged with `_headers`.
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the constants, tools and drift check shared by the operator verbs */

/** 🩺️ The `docker-image-check` verb: runs the image as the stack does (no configuration, read-only root, no capabilities) and checks what it is (labels, user, no shell, the stack files it carries) and the API as the CDN-hosted site meets it — ready behind the proxy, cleartext refused, cross-origin preflight and POST granted to the site origin only, the request body limit, shared presence between two learners, `docker stop` draining with exit code 0 while a socket is open, the WAL folded into `proctor.sqlite` on the volume.
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the constants, tools and drift check shared by the operator verbs */

/** 🧱️ The `docker-stack-check` verb: the stack exactly as a host gets it, proven on a throw-away project with Caddy's internal CA, from update to restore and erasure.
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the constants, tools and drift check shared by the operator verbs */

/** 🎁️ The `docker-stack-bundle` verb: what the proctor host needs without a registry — the stack files out of the image, an empty `certificates` directory, an `.env` that pins the tag, the image as `proctor-image.tar` and the host's steps.
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the constants, tools and drift check shared by the operator verbs */

/** ⚖️ The `deploy-check` verb: the readiness gate over drift, the course, `publish`, the image build, both checks and the end-to-end gate when the package has one.
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the constants, tools and drift check shared by the operator verbs */
